### Improved

- **Settings screen:** A new Material 3 Expressive design uses your wallpaper colors in light and dark mode.
- **Status card:** Problems such as a missing System Framework scope stand out in an error-colored card.

> [!NOTE]
> **Known issues**
>
> - **Framework support:** The module needs an Xposed framework with libxposed API 101 or newer, such as Vector 2.1 and later.
